title: Gate Stack
prompt: Use case: UI mockup. Asset type: high-fidelity north-star composition for the mobile-first Nudge training web app. Primary request: design composition option 2, "Gate Stack," using the committed international-airport-wayfinding visual world. Render a straight-on 390x844 portrait app viewport with no device bezel, no hands, and no surrounding scene. This is a real designed app surface, not a poster or airport scene. Structure in order: saturated-yellow shared shell with black Nudge wordmark and a quiet Catalog exit; a compact black phase sign reading Performance with 18:24 elapsed and a small Plan / Cooldown / Review route key; a stacked sequence of full-width sign rows rather than cards. The active row is a monumental black panel labeled "02 Dumbbell bench press" with "Set 2 of 3," editable 95 lb and 8 reps, and a white pictogram. A yellow inset inside the active row carries the single action "Start set" with an edge arrow. Directly below, a white/black paired row shows concurrent "Bench rest 1:12" and "Shoulder press available" without blocking the current action. Upcoming rows "03 Seated row" and "04 Plank" are compressed but legible. A slim final row keeps "Continue to Cooldown" and "Finish workout" available as quiet agency. Show the route hierarchy strongly enough to prove Plan through Review orientation. Style: airport yellow #FFCC00, jet black #0D0D0D, signal white, graphite and concrete neutrals; bold humanist sans similar to Frutiger, monumental tabular identifiers, strict aligned columns, inset black pictograms, matte enamel sign bands, squared corners, precise borders, large touch targets. No rounded-card dashboard, no gradients, no glow, no glass, no photography, no planes, no airport labels, no new navigation model, no trophies, streaks, praise, readiness score, scientific claims, urgency, guilt, coaching voice, or invented recommendation. Keep controls standard and state understandable without color. Synthetic workout content only. No watermark.
